description: Dynamic-array (spilling) functions. SEQUENCE is the first acceptance case for cell-level spill machinery; the oracle reads back the anchor scalar (top-left of the spill region) since xlwings does not surface phantom cells through a single-cell read.

cases.skipped: SEQUENCE error path returns Error scalar but golden registers an array-shaped error in some configurations; re-verify after oracle-gen rerun captures the live Mac result post-anchor-unwrap landing.

Spill-ref `A1#` consumed by SUM requires the spill region to be materialized in the workbook, but the oracle harness evaluates the formula in isolation; SUM sees the bare Array reference and produces a different result than Excel's resolved spill region.

Mac probe via xlwings reads blank for `=_xlfn.ANCHORARRAY(B1)` typed via the formula2 API even when B1 holds a static value. This is a harness probe artefact (Mac may not fully evaluate the explicit `_xlfn.` form when injected through xlwings) rather than the documented `ref#` semantics. Formulon implements the documented #REF! return for non-spill anchors, covered by spill_ref_eval_test.cpp.

Mac probe via xlwings reads blank for `=_xlfn.ANCHORARRAY(E1)` typed via formula2 even when E1 is genuinely blank. Same probe artefact as anchorarray_static_value_anchor — Formulon's #REF! is the documented semantics for a non-spill anchor.

_xlfn.ANCHORARRAY(A1) over a setup-formula spill source (A1=SEQUENCE(3)) requires the spill region to be materialized before the test formula is evaluated. The static oracle harness evaluates the test formula in isolation, so spill_region_at_anchor(A1) returns null and ANCHORARRAY surfaces #REF!. Same harness limitation as spill_ref_after_sequence_sum above.
_xlfn.ANCHORARRAY(A1) requires the A1=SEQUENCE(3) spill source to be materialized before the test formula evaluates. Same harness limitation as spill_ref_after_sequence_sum.
_xlfn.ANCHORARRAY(OFFSET(A1,1,0)) requires the A2=SEQUENCE(2,2) spill source to be materialized before the test formula evaluates. Same harness limitation as spill_ref_after_sequence_sum.
